snippet.title: Stadium Shift | SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Stadium Shift is an indie game inspired by Mr. Needlemouse and a Deranged Italian Chef where you stand between the fate of the world itself by doing smooth, fun and chainable moves all the way to the end of stages.

We hope to see you at SAGE 2025!!

Song by @Le_Blit 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Made by Sahara Studios
